ticket.title: Two tickets whose own descriptions say ALREADY DONE still sit in triage, so the queue overstates the open work
ticket.description:
MEASURED 2026-11-12 in the suite store, 80 listed tickets.

Two tickets are finished, say so in their own words, and sit in triage rather than closed:

  GB-268  triage  Every repo has empty verification_commands, so storypole verify runs nothing and records a manual receipt
          description ends: ALREADY DONE, verified 2026-11-10 - the harness config carries a populated
          verification_commands table (eleven repository chains plus gaugeblock and default entries), every
          member either declares its own chain or inherits the suite roster, and storypole config check reports
          zero findings and zero errors.

  GB-345  triage  ledger-verify reports zero and ledger-reconcile fails, both against the pre-migration ledger
          description ends: ALREADY DONE, verified 2026-11-10 - storypole ledger-verify replays 377 tasks across
          the suite and reports 0 unparsable and 0 duplicate records, and ledger-reconcile answers index and
          ledger agree.

Both claims are checkable today and both hold: the suite config really does carry a default entry alongside the per-crate chains, and ledger-verify / ledger-reconcile both answer correctly against the records layout. Neither ticket carries acceptance criteria, so nothing pins what closure was supposed to mean - which is plausibly why the work finished in the description instead of in the status.

Why it is not cosmetic: the triage queue is what a person and storypole next reason about when deciding what is owed, and two rows that state their own completion make it overstate the remaining work. This store has just completed the migration whose whole argument (ADR 0010) is that a ticket is a file that tells the truth. status is a task field and is not derived from events, so no projection can find this shape - refresh-projections agrees, ledger-verify agrees, config check agrees. It is only visible by reading descriptions against status.

Definition of done includes the sweep: if the same shape exists elsewhere, it belongs on this ticket rather than in a follow-up, and GB-350 / GB-351 / GB-352 are the other triage rows worth checking while the sweep is open.

Not in scope: rewriting either description's evidence. The receipts for GB-268 and GB-345 should cite what is already recorded there; if any part no longer holds, that is a new finding, and it gets its own ticket.

DONE 2026-11-12. Named pair closed with receipts: GB-268 verified on the storypole chain (exit 0) and archived; GB-345 likewise. Both claims re-checked first rather than trusted - storypole config check --workspace reports 11 repositories, 0 findings, 0 errors, and ledger-verify plus ledger-reconcile both answer (index and ledger agree).

SWEEP RESULT, eight triage rows carried the same shape and each was re-checked instead of rubber-stamped. Six hold and their evidence is recorded in their own descriptions: GB-269 (receipts.rs:160 appends :cargo-test-fallback), GB-289 (install/mod.rs is 203 lines), GB-348 (core_cmds/mod.rs:120 discloses the hidden archived count), GB-351 (remint/rules.rs holds the per-occurrence rule), GB-353 (index.sqlite and workspace.sqlite are distinct inodes), GB-352 (the regression test exists). These are re-checked, not yet chain-verified: their scope names storypole code, and the storypole chain runs the full workspace suite, so closing them properly is a batch of its own rather than a footnote here.

TWO ROWS DELIBERATELY NOT CLOSED. GB-260 says no ledger.jsonl exists at any depth; one does - common/.gaugeblock/storypole/ledger.jsonl, dead beside a store whose tickets/ directory makes Records authoritative - so the ticket is narrower than its own sentence, and it is noted there rather than closed. GB-350 reports a post-fix measurement (0 orphans, 0 dangling) but names no command, and no plan verb performs one, so it cannot be re-checked as written. GB-262 was read and is not done: its description ends with three open questions.
acceptance_criteria: GB-268 and GB-345 are verified or archived, each with a receipt that names the evidence already recorded in its own description
storypole list --status triage no longer lists either key
a sweep of the store for the same shape - triage or ready status while the description claims completion - finds no other instance, or records the others on this ticket
